The description fails to mention the hierarchical grouping of the x-axis categories. The labels are organized into three main sections: 'Въвеждане и обработка в БД', 'Честота на актуализиране на информацията', and 'Начин на набавяне на източниците на информацията...', which is a key structural feature of the chart.
The description of the y-axis states that the labels are at 'equal intervals' but does not specify that the major grid lines are marked at intervals of 2 units (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12).
